hero.lede: Independent practitioner working from our Earlwood Medical Centre and Sans Souci Doctors premises. Speech Pathologist.

paragraphs: Sarah Impellizzeri is a Certified Practising Speech Pathologist (ABN: 25 903 691 228) (SPA Member No: 34286) who holds a Master of Speech-Language Pathology from the University of Sydney, alongside degrees in Speech, Hearing, and Language Sciences, and Biomedical Science. As a Medicare-registered practitioner and a dedicated member of Speech Pathology Australia, she provides evidence-based care that meets the highest professional standards.

Sarah's primary focus is on paediatric speech pathology, working with children across a wide range of speech and language needs, including articulation, language development, fluency, and social communication. While her main expertise lies in working with children, Sarah also has experience supporting adults with complex conditions such as neurodegenerative conditions.

Sarah believes in a person-centred approach to therapy, understanding the importance of tailoring her treatment to the unique needs of each individual. She takes the time to listen, understand, and collaborate with families and care teams to create an individualised treatment plan that empowers her clients to build their communication skills and achieve their goals.

Outside of her clinical work, Sarah also works as a Project Manager / Product Owner in the development of a clinical reporting software, and volunteers as Executive Assistant for a not-for-profit organisation focused on child protection. In her personal time, she enjoys cooking and spending time with her dog, Barkley.
